description: Default capability for the monitor window: core defaults plus the notification (D4 daily summary / alerts), autostart (D4 launch-at-login switch), updater and process (D5 check-for-updates → download → relaunch) command sets, and the window setters the D11 geometry restore needs (size / position / show / maximize on the main window only — it owns the localStorage-driven restore-then-show). Tray and every other window management stay in Rust.
